consequence.statement: This is a documentation correction with no operational consequence to running systems or upgrade processes.

original.statement: A documentation fix corrected invalid version information in Gateway API documentation for Traefik v3, but the specific version values and documentation artifact affected are not detailed in the evidence.

decision.reason: [ev-66d1adabbaf2] lists this item under the v3.0.0 "Documentation" section of the changelog. It describes it only as a fix to an invalid version in the docs about Gateway API. Nothing in the evidence says any product behaviour, configuration, API or upgrade step changes. So a "none" consequence (informational) is supported, and no failure kind is justified.
